process.heading: How we work

steps.title: Discover
steps.description: We join your team. We learn your goals, your customers, and what matters most this year.

steps.title: Strategize
steps.description: We research your market and competitors. Then we set the plan for channels, messages, and priorities.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: We create the content, run the campaigns, and keep your website and marketing assets current.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.description: Weekly calls and monthly reports show what works. We cut what doesn't and back what does.

values.heading: How we operate
values.description: Small teams win on focus. So do we.

items.title: Embedded
items.description: We act as part of your team, not a vendor you brief once a quarter. We join your calls, learn your priorities, and own the work. When priorities change, we change with you.

items.title: Straight talk

items.question: Who is PrimeDesk for?
items.answer: Small businesses that want a full marketing team without hiring one. Our clients are in real estate, construction, legal, healthcare, and financial services.

items.question: Where are you based?
items.answer: Houston, Texas. Our team spans four countries, so work moves across time zones.

items.question: Can I hire you for one service?
items.answer: Yes. You can take the full program or a single service.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: You pay a flat monthly price based on the services you pick. We quote after a short call.

items.question: Why a 12-month term?
items.answer: Marketing takes time. The first three months go to setup and learning. Results build after that. A 12-month term lets us do the job properly.

items.question: How much of my time do you need?
items.answer: Most in the first three months. We need your direction, reviews, and feedback. A weekly call is standard. After that, we run the work.

items.question: Who does the work?
items.answer: A distributed team led by a project manager. The project manager is your point of contact.

items.question: Do you shoot photo or video on site?
items.answer: We refer a trusted local freelancer. You pay them directly.

items.question: What do you report on?
items.answer: Leads, traffic, ads, social, and reviews, in one monthly report.

items.question: Who owns my accounts, site, and content?
items.answer: You do. You keep access to your accounts, website, and assets at all times.
